line: update v0.4.5: new zones, better buses and ferries

items.text: added Pakistan and Bangladesh
items.edited: added Iraq, Iran, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Myanmar, Laos and Timor-Leste!

items.text: tram track can join regular and high-speed track, and trams can run on it at their own speed limit
items.edited: tram track can join to regular and high-speed track

items.text: ramps can be steeper where there's no room, at a lower speed, and high-speed ramps can be built for 320 km/h
items.edited: ramps can be steeper, which lowers speed cap. ramps can also be shallower and allow high-speed trains to run at full speed

items.text: track points light up under the pointer when you can move them
items.edited: track points light up under the pointer when you can drag to move them

items.text: trams top out at 75 km/h (was 80)
items.edited: tram max speed lowered to 75 km/h from 80 km/h

items.text: fixed the fastest train on a stretch sometimes showing an impossible speed
items.edited: fixed the fastest train on a stretch occasionally showing an impossible speed

items.text: fixed high-speed trains slowing to 160 km/h at each end of a ramp up to a bridge or over other track
buses no longer have a boarding cost, people walk up to 600 m to a route, routes cost almost nothing to build, and the bus fare starts at 0.8x
items.edited: buses no longer have a boarding cost, bus catchment area expanded to 600m

items.text: walking no longer gets a head start, 1 in 10 people won't walk past 800 m, and stairs at a station below or above ground add 2 minutes at each end of a train or tram trip
items.edited: bonus for walking-only trips is removed, so very short bus or tram trips are much more frequent. boarding a train or tram adds 2 minutes at each end of the trip.

items.text: more people ride ferries for fun, now on errands, school and airport trips too
items.edited: some people choose to prefer ferries on commutes, errands, school and airport trips

items.text: ferries between islands with no road or flight between them now carry riders
items.edited: demand fixed between islands that have no road or flight connecting them, so ferries between islands work better

items.text: the timetable zooms with the scroll wheel and replaces the separate timetable chart
items.edited: the timetable can zoom, timetable shows related lines

items.text: fixed loop lines over one-way track turning trains back at a station or going around twice
fixed a copied line having service only at midday when using more demand periods
fixed weekend trains bunching up on shared track when a line runs other trains on weekends
added fares by city: the advanced fares panel can set a fare multiple for each city instead of each country
items.edited: option to set fares by city instead of by country

items.text: added set zones by distance to the fare zones tool, which gives stations fare zones in rings around a station you click; new stations and bus stops take the fare zone of the nearest station with one
items.edited: can quick set fare zones by distance from a reference point

items.text: added a cities list to the schematic that draws only the cities you tick, laid out on their own
items.edited: added toggle for cities in the generated schematic map

items.text: added buses and ferries to the schematic as thin lines, and buttons to show or hide trains, trams, buses and ferries
items.edited: added buses and ferries to the schematic map, and toggles to filter by mode of transport

items.text: rivers in the schematic are drawn as one straightened course each, with stations on their own bank
items.edited: schematic rivers drawn more continuously

items.text: the track level view marks where each ramp starts and ends
fixed station names with a slash being cut short in the schematic
fixed the downloaded schematic image coming out tiny in a mostly blank frame
added a profit leaderboard beside the points one, ranking games by profit on a weekday
items.edited: added a profit leaderboard parallel to points leaderboard

items.text: added Guyana, Suriname, French Guiana, Guadeloupe, Martinique, the US and British Virgin Islands, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Martin, Bonaire, Saba and Sint Eustatius, Montserrat, Anguilla, Turks and Caicos and Saint-Barthélemy
items.edited: added rest of Caribbean!

items.text: added a BRT upgrade for bus lines: bus lanes so its buses run at least 35 km/h, paid for only where the route is in town
items.edited: added a BRT upgrade for bus lines: bus lanes make its buses run at least 35 km/h, paid for only where the route is in town

items.text: while drawing a bus route, trunk roads and motorways, where buses run fastest, are drawn wider and other roads fainter
items.edited: while drawing a bus route, trunk roads, where buses run faster, are drawn in blue

items.text: buses run at least 25 km/h between stops (was 30), and on trunk roads and motorways at most 1.4x their street speed
items.edited: dense city bus speed reduced to 25 km/h from 30 km/h, trunk road bus speed also reduced

items.text: added a panel for bus stops, with the lines stopping there and the stops a short walk away, and bus stops that connect are joined on the map
items.edited: better indication for bus interchanges

items.text: added small and large boats for ferries beside the medium one, picked on the ferry line's panel
items.edited: added small and large ferries. ferry running cost lowered by 25%

items.text: added ferry waypoints: shift click on water while drawing a ferry route to make it pass there
items.edited: added ferry waypoints: after a port, shift click on water to make the route pass there

items.text: shift click a ferry route's end port to extend the route from that end
added a gear to the lines tab to filter lines by type and city and choose which columns show
added sorting by type to the lines tab
items.edited: added a mode of transport column to lines tab, can sort by mode

items.text: added a setting to split transit into ferry, tram, train, high speed and bus in the mode split bars
items.edited: added a setting to split transit into specific mode of transit (tram, bus, etc.) in travel mode bars

items.text: added line groups inside line groups, to any depth
items.edited: line groups can nest inside each other

items.text: the game can be added to a phone's home screen and opens full screen like an app
items.edited: the game can be added to a phone's home screen and opens like an app

items.text: fixed big games that ran low on memory failing to save, copy or download
fixed the construct button needing two clicks while naming a new line
fixed train lines accepting ferry ports as stops
the bus tool shows each stretch's speed while placing a waypoint
fixed trams being counted as trains when calculating trips
ferries cost a quarter less to run
each ferry boat size has its own fare multiple, and small boats start at 1.5x
new ferry lines over 40 km start with a boat an hour and none at night
fixed undo not putting other lines' trains back as they were, as after adding a line on full track
fixed the station ghost turning red a moment after it appeared at the end of track that crosses other track
changing train counts on lines that share track shows up faster, most in london
street trams can run on highways
fixed trains bought by adding a stop, and station upgrades, being counted in no region in the money panel
fixed the calculating trips bar starting over each time you build during a long calculation; it now follows the time left
added Iraq and Iran
added Myanmar, Laos and Timor-Leste
items.edited: added

items.text: fixed panning the schematic so far that nothing showed
fixed trip routes and the gap flash sitting off their places on very large screens
fixed the schematic's drawing indicator going away before the whole network was drawn
fixed far-away track with no line on it moving the schematic
edits show up faster on big games while the lines tab is open
items.edited: edits show up faster on big games
